PatchNoteRelease.title: PatchNoteRelease
PatchNoteRelease.description: Published version release and categorized changelog notes visible to all players.

version.description: Semantic version label such as v1.4.0

isCurrent.description: Whether this release is the highlighted active version

isPublished.description: Explicit publication marker for secure public queries

entries.description: Bounded list (max 40) of categorized patch note items

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest update

updatedBy.description: Admin UID who published or edited the release

PatchNoteDraft.title: PatchNoteDraft
PatchNoteDraft.description: Private admin-only draft of upcoming patch notes before public publication.

entries.description: Bounded list (max 40) of draft changelog entries

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest draft save

updatedBy.description: Admin UID who saved the draft

ModeQueuesConfig.title: ModeQueuesConfig
ModeQueuesConfig.description: Global availability switches and optional maintenance notices for each game mode queue.

pvp_ranked.description: Availability status for Ranked PvP queue

pvp_normal.description: Availability status for Normal PvP queue

pvia.description: Availability status for PvIA solo queue

testing_arena.description: Availability status for Testing Arena sandbox

tutorial.description: Availability status for Interactive Tutorial mode

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest queue configuration update

updatedBy.description: Verified Admin UID who updated the queue states

RankPolicyConfig.title: RankPolicyConfig
RankPolicyConfig.description: Global ranked progression lock configuration allowing administrators to cap visible rank below a target tier while points keep accumulating.

blockedFromTier.description: Tier from which progression is capped globally, or 'none' when unlocked

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest rank policy update

updatedBy.description: Verified Admin UID who updated the global rank policy

/patch_notes/{releaseId}.description: Publicly readable published patch note releases (current version and chronological history). Only verified admin can create, update, or delete.

/patch_drafts/{draftId}.description: Private patch notes drafts accessible exclusively by verified admin.

/admins/{userId}.description: Read-own-only admin lookup documents. Client writes are always forbidden.

/game_config/{configId}.description: Global game configuration documents (mode_queues and rank_policy). Public get for all clients; verified admin-only create/update.
